title: No key without a secret, no encoding that is no point (AUD-026)
note: Stage 5. ED1 puts back the reference code's unreduced x^2, so y = p - 1 with the sign bit decodes; ED2 and ED5 let either verifier take a key of small order; ED3, ED6 and ED7 let either registry hold one, or a non-point; ED4 tests order four, so the four points of order eight pass; ED8 skips decoding. tests/test_ed25519_encodings.py holds each against both implementations.

mutations.name: ED1_x2_unreduced
mutations.rationale: the RFC reference code's quirk: x = 0 with the sign bit set decodes as (0, -1)

mutations.name: ED2_verify_takes_small_order_keys
mutations.find: if a_pt is None or r_pt is None or _small_order(a_pt):
mutations.replace: if a_pt is None or r_pt is None:
mutations.rationale: a signature nobody made verifies under a key of small order

mutations.name: ED3_the_registry_holds_any_key
mutations.rationale: a principal is registered under a key anyone can sign with

mutations.name: ED4_small_order_by_four
mutations.rationale: the four points of order eight are taken for keys

mutations.name: ED5_restated_verify_takes_small_order_keys
mutations.find: if a is None or r is None or s >= _ED_L or _ed_small(a):
mutations.replace: if a is None or r is None or s >= _ED_L:
mutations.rationale: the restated verifier accepts a signature nobody made

mutations.name: ED6_restated_registry_takes_small_order
mutations.rationale: the portable verifier reads a registry holding a key anyone can sign with

mutations.name: ED7_restated_registry_takes_non_points
mutations.rationale: an encoding that is no point is read as the base point, and held

mutations.name: ED8_public_key_problem_skips_decoding
mutations.find:
if pt is None:
        return "not the canonical encoding of a curve point"
mutations.replace:
if pt is None:
        return None
mutations.rationale: a non-point is reported as no problem
